findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "p_easyjur" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: easyjur_list_oportunidades · Private data: easyjur_list_tokens, easyjur_get_token, connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: report_bug · Destructive: marketplace.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: easyjur_list_oportunidades · Private data: easyjur_list_tokens, easyjur_get_token, connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: report_bug · Destructive: marketplace

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
